rule.description: /a/ is [e] before y or ʃ, and [a] elsewhere
/d/ is [r] before a syllable-final a or i, and [d] elsewhere
/s/ is [ʃ] before e or i, and [s] elsewhere
/i/ is [e] in a closed syllable, and [i] elsewhere
/u/ is [o] after q or r, and [u] elsewhere
/u/ is [o] in a closed syllable, and [u] elsewhere
/i/ is [e] before a word-final k or q, and [i] elsewhere
/a/ is [o] before a syllable-final n or ŋ, and [a] elsewhere
/k/ is [q] after a or o, and [k] elsewhere
/s/ is [h] before a word-final a or u, and [s] elsewhere
